verdict.rationale: Secureframe lists ISO 27001 as a dedicated supported framework aimed at achieving and maintaining certification. Its framework docs describe control mapping and automated control testing that collects compliance evidence. Nothing in the pack shows the current Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts, so first-class depth beyond mapping is unproven. Missing for 10: current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation/management, ISO certification-audit artifacts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification so you can focus on growing your business globally.
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
